transfer_taxes.name: Colorado documentary fee
transfer_taxes.source_title: C.R.S. 39-13-102; Denver Clerk & Recorder: Record Documents
transfer_taxes.notes: 1 cent per $100 ($0.10 per $1,000) when consideration > $500. Statute (https://colorado.public.law/statutes/crs_39-13-102) imposes it on the person offering the deed for recording (typically buyer side). Denver page lists no separate transfer tax.
